game.title.description: Name of the Star Swarm game card.
game.title.notes: Do not translate the game name.

game.description.description: One-line description on the Star Swarm game card.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Star Swarm play button.

game.canvasLabel.description: Accessible label for the game canvas — describes game and interaction.

hud.scoreValue.description: In-canvas HUD text showing the current score, top-left during play.
hud.scoreValue.notes: All caps in English, matching hud.guns/hud.hull; the limit counts the raw {{score}}.

hud.bestValue.description: In-canvas HUD text showing the player's best score, top-center during play.
hud.bestValue.notes: All caps in English, matching hud.guns/hud.hull.

hud.waveValue.description: In-canvas HUD text showing the current wave number, top-right during play, and again centered ('— WAVE {{wave}} —') on the wave-clear overlay.
hud.waveValue.notes: All caps in English, matching hud.guns/hud.hull.

phase.missionComplete.description: Overlay banner shown when the player clears the final wave and wins the run.
phase.missionComplete.notes: All caps in English to match the other phase banners.

phase.waveClear.description: Overlay text shown for a moment when the player clears a wave.

phase.bossWave.description: Overlay banner while a boss wave's ships swoop in: the Carrier and its four Boss escorts, nothing else (#2490).
phase.bossWave.notes: Carrier is the large top-row enemy ship (#2484). All caps in English to match the other phase banners.

phase.rout.description: Overlay banner while the wave's surviving grunts flee for the top edge after every Elite, Boss and Carrier is destroyed (#2489).
phase.rout.notes: A rout is a panicked retreat. All caps in English to match the other phase banners.

score.display.description: Accessibility label for the score display.

controls.chargeShotLabel.description: Accessibility label for the charge shot button.

controls.paused.description: Large text shown in the pause overlay.

controls.resume.description: Text on the Resume button in the pause overlay.

controls.pauseLabel.description: Accessibility label for the pause button while the game is running.

controls.resumeLabel.description: Accessibility label for the pause-overlay resume pressable.

controls.newGameFromPause.description: Text on the New Game button in the pause overlay, which discards the saved run.

controls.newGameFromPauseLabel.description: Accessibility label for the New Game button in the pause overlay, warning that it discards the saved run.

difficulty.selectTitle.description: Title of the pre-game difficulty picker.

difficulty.start.description: Button to start the game from the pre-game difficulty picker.

a11y.carrierExposed.description: Screen-reader announcement when the last Boss escort dies and the Carrier's force field drops, so it can now be damaged by ordinary shots.
a11y.carrierExposed.notes: Carrier is the large top-row enemy ship added in #2484.

a11y.carrierBeam.description: Screen-reader announcement when the Carrier starts charging its sweep beam; the player has about 0.6 s to move out of the column below it.
a11y.carrierBeam.notes: Carrier is the large top-row enemy ship (#2484); the beam is #2485.

a11y.reinforcements.description: Screen-reader announcement when the Carrier launches replacement grunts into the formation.

a11y.bossWave.description: Screen-reader announcement when a boss wave begins (#2490).
a11y.bossWave.notes: Carrier is the large top-row enemy ship (#2484); escorts are its four Bosses.

a11y.rout.description: Screen-reader announcement when the grunts rout, with how many are fleeing (#2489).
a11y.rout.notes: {{count}} is an integer (1–40). Phrased so the number can sit after a colon and avoid plural forms.

hud.guns.description: HUD label before the gun level number (1–3). Rendered as e.g. 'GUNS L2'.

hud.hull.description: HUD label before the hull plating pips.

a11y.gunsUp.description: Screen-reader cue after collecting a salvage crate.

a11y.gunsDown.description: Screen-reader cue when a lost life drops the gun level.

a11y.hullUp.description: Screen-reader cue after collecting hull plating.

a11y.hullHit.description: Screen-reader cue when hull plating absorbs a hit instead of a life.

result.reachedWave.description: Result card subtitle stating which wave the run reached.

result.wave.description: Stat label for the wave reached, shown in the result card's stat strip.
